no-pride queerhana under the bridge, 200.description: A daytime gathering on a riverbank under a bridge in Yaffa-Tel Aviv, 27 June 2003.

queerhana furry tale, june 2005.description: A daytime gathering in woodland, 14 June 2005, in Yarkon Park, Ramat Gan — the site of Jarisha, a Palestinian village whose residents were expelled in 1948.

allenbeach reclaim the streets action, 8.description: One of the Allenbeach crew's reclaim-the-streets actions, a series of street parties in reclaimed public space from which Queerhana emerged. Held in a road underpass in Yaffa-Tel Aviv, 8 March 2003.

allenbeach reclaim the streets action, 1.description: One of the Allenbeach crew's reclaim-the-streets actions, a series of street parties in reclaimed public space from which Queerhana emerged. Held in Yaffa-Tel Aviv, 15-18 March 2003.

pink communities coalition, 2009.description: Material from the Pink Communities Coalition, established by activists, culture benders and community figures in response to the 2009 shooting at an LGBTQ youth centre in Tel Aviv. Queerhana was among the participating groups.

queerhana four-day festival, september 2.description: An independent four-day festival in Yaffa-Tel Aviv.

this is a free zone, ngbk berlin, 2017.description: The 2017 retrospective at nGbK Berlin, titled this is a free zone.

timeout photoshoot (unpublished).description: A photoshoot from 24 December 2006, by invitation of TimeOut magazine. It was never published, as the Queerhana crew insisted on being photographed with covered faces. Two frames of eleven people posed on a rooftop at night against the lit city skyline, heads covered by decorated shopping bags; legible lettering includes GAY IS DEAD. In the second frame the faces are uncovered.

haritz parties.description: A series of parties produced by Queerhana veterans, giving the community a place to gather and to celebrate otherness and togetherness.

queerhana chuchu.description: A night and day gathering in a secluded location outside Yaffa-Tel Aviv. Activists, drag, body-positive celebration and community coming-together.

down to the atlantis queerhana.description: A queerhana party announced as an underwater rave while the whole country sinks into fascism.
